scope: P-07 normalized resource comparison; not a repository-wide production profile selection

B_off.name: offline_construction_work
B_off.units: declared structural event counters; no scalar conversion across event classes

R_extra.name: persistent_representation
R_extra.disclosure: report total resident profile bytes and derive extra bytes against the baseline delta table

K.name: correctness_observability
K.semantic_reference: exact labeled predecessor fiber F(u) from the current delta

event_counters.offline_state_reads: generic state reads during initial construction
event_counters.offline_state_writes: generic state writes during initial construction
event_counters.offline_hash_probes: hash probes during initial hash-index construction
event_counters.offline_hash_writes: hash writes during initial hash-index construction
event_counters.offline_link_writes: fiber link/head writes during initial construction
event_counters.initial_build_entries: entries processed by the initial CSR constructor
event_counters.rebuild_entries: entries processed by M1 rebuild publication
event_counters.shift_entries: CSR payload entries shifted by generic mutation
event_counters.offset_writes: CSR offset cells rewritten by generic mutation

A1_RW_CSR.representation: exact contiguous inverse CSR with fixed capacity S*Sigma

P07_HASH.representation: per-target fiber buckets plus membership hash table
P07_HASH.specialized_inverse_operation: profile interface, not used to infer production necessity

P07_CSR_REBUILD_M1.representation: contiguous CSR rebuilt at each publication boundary

P07_CSR_OVERLAY.representation: immutable CSR base plus latest-update overlay and explicit compaction

fixed_experimental_envelope.target_distribution: same fixed query trace generated from initial in-degree quartiles plus top 5 percent stratum
fixed_experimental_envelope.rebuild_publication: after each update epoch and before its query batch

rules.same_trace: All profiles in a case receive byte-identical initial delta, update trace, and query trace.
rules.dynamic_consistency: A1_RW_CSR, P07_HASH, and P07_CSR_OVERLAY must validate affected fibers and representation invariants after every committed update.
rules.batched_consistency: P07_CSR_REBUILD_M1 is only required to validate after rebuild publication; it is not an M2 equivalence claim.
rules.no_free_rebuild: rebuild and compaction events are charged explicitly to the profile that performs them.
rules.no_scalarization: event-counter dimensions remain separate; wall-clock is reported separately and never converted into structural units.
rules.no_production_inference: synthetic workload results remain scenario evidence, not production workload evidence.
rules.classification: This contract supports resource-vector comparison only; it does not select a universal profile.
